Energy Infrastructure

Explore related projects

Infrastructure for what comes next.

BOW's Queensland team is developing grid-scale battery energy storage in Central Queensland, from site identification and approvals through to construction and delivery coordination. Our two current projects are the Mt Miller BESS and the Gladstone BESS at the Port of Gladstone. Both support grid stability and peak demand in a region that is rebuilding itself around clean energy, and both draw on the same discipline we bring to a building site: get the ground, the approvals and the programme right before anything is poured.

How we can help

  • Site identification and approvals
  • Grid-scale battery energy storage development
  • Construction and delivery coordination
  • Grid stability and peak demand infrastructure
